title: Jamaican Sausage Gratin
description: A flavorful twist on a classic gratin, featuring the spicy kick of Jamaican sausage.
instructions: Cook the sausage in a large skillet over medium-high, browning on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausage from the skillet and set aside. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced potatoes, cooked onion, and browned sausage.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the heavy cream and a pinch of salt and pepper. Pour the cream mixture over the potato mixture and toss to coat.
Transfer the potato mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with the grated cheddar cheese.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the potatoes are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Let the dish rest for 5 minutes before serving.
